name: Streakr - Settlement Notify
notes:
Receives a settlement outcome and posts it to a Room's Telegram chat.

TRIGGER: the streakr-poll-pending-calls Lambda (backend/lambda/src/handlers/pollPendingCalls.ts, via src/n8n.ts) POSTs a SettlementNotifyPayload here every time a call settles. Set N8N_SETTLEMENT_WEBHOOK_URL on that Lambda to this webhook's PRODUCTION url (not the test url — the test url only accepts a request while the editor is listening). No Lambda code change is needed; the poller already POSTs when the variable is set and logs a warning and continues when it isn't.

n8n env vars: STREAKR_DEFAULT_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
Credentials: a Telegram bot token (create via @BotFather).

The bot must be a member of the target group, and for a group the chat id is negative (e.g. -1001234567890).

Rooms all post to one shared chat here, which is the right scope for a demo. For per-room chats, resolve telegramChatId upstream with a Firestore lookup node — the Code node already prefers $json.telegramChatId when present.
